text: { "name": "Maren Ashvein", "age": 19, "facts": [ { "category": "appearance", "text": "She stands five foot six, stocky and solidly built like her Lowlander mother, with broad shoulders and thick arms corded with muscle from years of hammering." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her skin is a mottled grey-green, darker on her arms and shoulders where soot and forge heat have weathered it, with olive undertones along her cheeks and jaw that betray her human blood." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her black hair is cropped short and uneven, hacked off with a knife rather than combed, and it sticks to her forehead with sweat during long work sessions." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Two dark brown tusks jut up from her lower jaw, slightly longer than average for someone her age, giving her a perpetually serious or defiant look." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her eyes are a striking amber-gold, sharp and watchful, set beneath a heavy brow ridge that casts a shadow over them when she frowns." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Calloused hands and forearms are marked with old burns and hammer dents, though her fingers are surprisingly deft when they need to be." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "She has a quick, volatile temper that flares hot and fast, earning her a reputation in the town as someone to avoid when she's been insulted." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "Beneath the anger, she is fiercely loyal to her master, Aldric the blacksmith, and will defend his work and reputation with the same ferocity she defends her own name." }, { "category": "background", "text": "Raised in the frontier town of Grannet, she began apprenticing at Aldric's forge at fifteen after her mother, a Lowlander seamstress, died of a fever and left her no other family." } ] }

text: { "name": "Brenna Ironhand", "age": 19, "facts": [ { "category": "appearance", "text": "She stands five foot seven, with a stocky, broad-shouldered frame that betrays her Lowlander blood." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her skin is a mottled grey-green along her forearms and cheeks, darkening to slate where her sleeves ride up, but her face and hands carry the warm olive tone of her human heritage." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Two blunt lower tusks jut above her upper lip, though they are shorter than a full-blooded orc's, barely half an inch long, giving her jawline an uneven look." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her hair is a coarse, dark black that she keeps cropped short and practical, perpetually dusted with soot and coal ash." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "She has yellow-green eyes that catch the light of the forge like a cat's, making her seem watchful even when she's daydreaming." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "A long scar runs across the back of her left hand from a hammer slip during her first month as an apprentice, a badge she wears without shame." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "Her temper flares fast and hot, and she has been known to slam her hammer down hard enough to crack the anvil's base when frustrated with a stubborn piece of iron." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "Despite her sharp tongue, she is fiercely loyal to her master and will work through the night without complaint when asked, feeling a deep sense of duty to the forge." }, { "category": "background", "text": "She is the only child of a Lowlander river merchant and an orcish woodsman who met at a frontier trade fair and stayed for love, though their marriage was frowned upon by both communities." } ] }

text: { "name": "Maren Ashwing", "age": 19, "facts": [ { "category": "appearance", "text": "She stands at five foot four, her compact Lowlander frame inherited from her human mother, with a broad-shouldered build typical of the river plains stock." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her skin is a warm olive-brown, sun-darkened from years of working near the forge, with faint soot smudges that never quite wash out of the creases of her palms." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her hair is a thick, dark brown that falls unevenly past her shoulders, often pulled back in a loose braid or tucked behind her ears to keep it out of the sparks." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her eyes are large and round, like her owl-folk father's, with bright yellow irises that give her an unsettling, unblinking stare when she's concentrating on her work." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Feathery tufts of white plumage sprout from behind her ears and along the ridge of her brow, a trait that marks her mixed heritage and which she keeps trimmed short to avoid catching fire." }, { "category": "appearance", "text": "Her taloned feet, broad and strong like a snowy owl's, grip the floorboards with a click when she walks, and she uses them deftly to hold nails and small ingots while hammering." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "She has a quick temper and a sharper tongue than most in the town, snapping at anyone who questions her skill or her father's legacy as the finest blade-smith on the frontier." }, { "category": "personality", "text": "Despite her fiery mood, she is deeply loyal to her master, Old Torben, and will argue with anyone who speaks ill of him, standing her ground even when outmatched in size or rank." }, { "category": "background", "text": "She is the only child of a Lowlander river-trader and a snowy owl-folk outcast who settled in the frontier town decades ago, raised in her father's smithy after her mother died when Maren was small." } ] }
